llm.summary: This is a Chinese-language mental health support reference skill with crisis guidance, but it does not install code, persist data, access credentials, or hide unrelated behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem, network, credential, account, or tool authority beyond providing textual guidance and reference material.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation only and a standard clawhub install command; no executable install scripts, dependencies, or remote payload behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The triggers include broad terms like wanting to chat or relax, so users should expect it may activate for general emotional conversations; the safety and referral instructions are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, privilege escalation, memory writes, or local data indexing behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's mental-health, screening, CBT, psychiatry, and crisis-intervention content matches its stated purpose, and the main files repeatedly state it is not diagnostic and cannot replace professional care.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want Chinese-language mental-health support and reference material. Do not treat it as therapy, diagnosis, medication advice, or emergency care; in imminent danger use local emergency services or a current crisis hotline, and verify hotline numbers for your region.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The artifact is Chinese-first and provides China-focused hotline resources; this is a real usability and localization limitation, but the language and regional resources are coherent with the skill text rather than hidden behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad trigger words could cause over-activation for ordinary emotional conversations, but they are disclosed in the skill description and do not grant the skill extra authority.
[SQP-2] expected: The references include self-help, crisis, and breathing exercises; the main README, SKILL.md, assessment, diagnostic, and psychiatric files contain non-diagnostic and professional-help limits, though users should still treat the content as supportive rather than clinical care.
[SDI-1] expected: Diagnostic criteria and screening scales are present, but they are framed as reference and screening material with explicit limits against diagnosis and medication prescribing.
